brief:
Torrential rain triggered the collapse of a sand embankment onto tents in Gaza, killing a woman and three small children, The Guardian reported. Hundreds of thousands of displaced Palestinians face such dangers as the winter rainy season sets in.

Makeshift shelters housing displaced residents lack adequate protection from severe weather. The deaths occurred as Palestinians living in temporary camps across the territory confront the seasonal conditions.
dek: Torrential rain in Gaza caused a sand embankment to collapse on to tents, killing a woman and three small children in an incident that highlighted the danger facing hundreds of thousands of displaced Palestinians as the rainy winter season sets in.
title: Sand embankment collapse kills four in Gaza amid winter rains
